Function reference

Residential concentration

Block data for places and measures of how concentrated a group is.

seg_blocks()
Census blocks with place assignments and Hispanic or Latino counts
seg_cluster_blocks()
Label each block with its majority-group cluster
seg_clusters()
Contiguous clusters of majority-group blocks
seg_measures()
Aspatial concentration measures for places

Composite indices

Normalize and combine indicators, and test how ranks depend on the choices.

idx_combine()
Combine indicators into a composite index
idx_normalize()
Normalize indicators to a common scale
idx_sensitivity()
Sensitivity of index ranks to construction choices

Spatial access

Population-weighted origins, travel costs and E2SFCA access scores.

acc_centroids()
Population-weighted centroids of larger units
acc_cost_matrix()
Origin-destination costs
acc_e2sfca()
Enhanced two-step floating catchment area (E2SFCA) access

Validation

Aggregate unit scores to survey units and extract shrunken group effects from multilevel models.

val_aggregate()
Weighted aggregation of unit scores to larger units
val_group_effects()
Shrunken group effects from a multilevel model

ca_place_concentration
Latino residential concentration in California places, 2010 and 2020
